item.title: Version 1.50.9 (141)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.50.9

Build 141

  • Asks before merging when a destination folder already exists
  • Offers Merge, Create copy, and Cancel before changing files
  • Removes culling checkboxes from normal folder browsing
  • Opens in native macOS fullscreen on launch
